datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2019 in South Sudan. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON and KML formats) representing food insecurity scenarios and severity levels across administrative units.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and affected populations.
